apiOperations.name: base
apiOperations.raw:
identity:
  role_mode: first
  role_claims: [role]
roles:
  - name: reviewer
    comment: Manual role
sources:
  - name: shop
    kind: database
    access:
      read: authenticated
      grants:
        - role: reviewer
          tables:
            - name: public.audit
              columns: [id]
  - name: crm
    kind: database
  - name: payments
    kind: api
    specs:
      stripe:
        operations:
          refund:
            allowed_roles: [admin, og_stale]
          list: {}

readModes.name: after apply
readModes.raw:
identity:
  role_mode: union
  role_claims: [ role, roles ]
  group_claims:
    - groups
roles:
  - name: reviewer
    comment: Manual role
  - name: og_everyone
    comment: OpenNeko group Everyone
  - name: og_finance
    comment: OpenNeko group Finance
  - name: og_support
    comment: OpenNeko group Support
sources:
  - name: shop
    kind: database
    access:
      read: admin
      grants:
        - role: reviewer
          tables:
            - name: public.audit
              columns: [ id ]
        - role: og_everyone
          tables:
            - name: public.products
              columns:
                - id
                - name
                - price
        - role: og_finance
          tables:
            - name: public.customers
              columns:
                - id
                - email
              filter: "{ owner_id: { eq: $user_id } }"
            - name: public.orders
              columns:
                - id
                - amount
                - region
              filter: "{ and: [{ region: { in: $user_groups } }, { or: [{ amount: { gt: 100 }
                }, { archived_at: { is_null: true } }] }] }"
  - name: crm
    kind: database
    access:
      read: admin
  - name: payments
    kind: api
    specs:
      stripe:
        operations:
          refund:
            allowed_roles:
              - admin
              - og_finance
          list: { allowed_roles: [ og_everyone, og_support ] }

applies.content:
sources:
  - name: erp
    kind: database
    access:
      read: admin
      namespace_column: tenant_id
      grants:
        - role: og_everyone
          tables:
            - name: invoices
              columns:
                - id
                - total
              filter: "{ tenant_id: { eq: $account_id } }"
        - role: og_finance
          tables:
            - name: invoices
              columns:
                - id
                - total
                - cost
              filter: '{ and: [{ tenant_id: { eq: $account_id } }, { status: { neq: "draft" }
                }] }'
  - name: default_acct
    kind: database
    access:
      read: admin
      grants:
        - role: og_everyone
          tables:
            - name: public.items
              columns:
                - id
              filter: "{ account_id: { eq: $account_id } }"
  - name: notes
    kind: database
    access:
      read: admin
      owner_column: author_id
      grants:
        - role: og_everyone
          tables:
            - name: memo
              columns:
                - id
                - body
              filter: "{ and: [{ author_id: { eq: $user_id } }, { pinned: { eq: true } }] }"
  - name: default_owner
    kind: database
    access:
      read: admin
      grants:
        - role: og_everyone
          tables:
            - name: tasks
              columns:
                - id
              filter: "{ user_id: { eq: $user_id } }"
  - name: files_src
    kind: file
identity:
  role_mode: union
  role_claims:
    - role
    - roles
  group_claims:
    - groups
roles:
  - name: og_everyone
    comment: OpenNeko group Everyone
  - name: og_finance
    comment: OpenNeko group Finance
